title: Custom software & modernization

Off-the-shelf software that forces your team to work the wrong way
A legacy application that's slow, risky to change, and hard to hire for
Data trapped in disconnected tools with no single source of truth

A clear data model and admin tooling your team can operate
Source code and full IP ownership handed over to you

Short build iterations with working software you can review
Launch, then hand over code, docs and knowledge to your team

title: Integrations & AI automation
tagline: Connect your tools and automate the manual work between them
summary: We connect the systems you already use — CRMs, accounting, payments, support, internal apps — and automate the repetitive work between them, including AI-assisted automation for tasks like document handling, triage and drafting.
who: Teams losing hours to copy-paste between tools, re-keying data, or chasing information across systems that don't talk to each other.
problems: The same data entered by hand into two or three different systems
Tools that don't integrate, creating silos and reconciliation work
Repetitive back-office tasks (sorting, tagging, drafting, routing) that eat staff time
No reliable, logged sync between your key systems
deliverables: Reliable integrations with authentication, retries and error logging
Automated workflows that remove specific manual steps
AI-assisted automations where they measurably save time (e.g. document extraction, classification, draft generation) — with a human review step
Monitoring and alerts so you know when something upstream breaks
approach: Map every system, data flow and manual step involved
Prioritize the automations with the clearest time saving
Build with secure auth, idempotency and full logging
Measure the time saved and tune from there
tech: REST and webhook integrations, message queues
Payments & finance: Stripe, PayPal, QuickBooks, Xero
CRM & support: Zoho, HubSpot, Salesforce, Twilio, SendGrid
AI automation: OpenAI and similar LLM APIs, document & vision pipelines
Health & device APIs where relevant to the project
boundaries: AI is used where it reliably helps — we don't add it for its own sake, and we keep a human in the loop for anything consequential.
We're honest about accuracy limits and build review/fallback steps into AI workflows.
We integrate with your approved tools and keep credentials server-side.

faqs.q: Is the AI reliable enough to trust?
faqs.a: For well-scoped tasks (extraction, classification, drafting) it saves real time, but we design workflows with validation and human review rather than full autonomy for anything that matters.

faqs.q: Will this break when a provider changes their API?
faqs.a: We build with error handling and monitoring so failures are caught and alerted, not discovered weeks later.

faqs.q: Can you automate just one painful process first?
faqs.a: Yes — that's usually the best way to start and prove the value before expanding.
